title: ResearchRunConfigContracts
$comment: C1/A-R04: an agentic research run against an industry workspace is configured without a project, a scenario or a published industry pack. A *run* binds only the public execution config it actually needs (the enabled public data tools and registered compute), so the common tool gateway depends on PublicExecutionConfig rather than a full scenario ResolvedProfile. The workspace-research profile is a separate, versioned branch that pins the exact workspace draft revision/digest it models and can never be mistaken for an industry-pack profile.

PublicExecutionConfig.title: PublicExecutionConfig
PublicExecutionConfig.description: The narrow public execution config the tool gateway and the runtime actually consume: the enabled public data tools and the registered compute operations the run may call. A scenario ResolvedProfile satisfies this structurally (it carries both arrays), so the gateway never has to depend on an industry-pack profile it does not use.

WorkspaceResearchProfileSpec.title: WorkspaceResearchProfileSpec
WorkspaceResearchProfileSpec.description: The versioned workspace-research run-config spec. It fixes the real workspace and the exact immutable draft revision it models (workspaceId + draftRevision + draftRef) and the public execution config, and deliberately has no industryRef and no mappingRefs: a research run starts from an empty workspace, before any industry pack is published. The model is bound per-execution (industry_workspace + research), never here.

ResolvedWorkspaceResearchProfile.title: ResolvedWorkspaceResearchProfile
ResolvedWorkspaceResearchProfile.description: WorkspaceResearchProfileSpec plus the exact resolved component versions, the explicit degradations and a deterministic snapshot hash. It is written once for one (workspaceId, draftRevision) and never rewritten, so editing the workspace draft later can never retarget an in-flight run's configuration.
